$comment: Input to scripts/check_release_health.py. Desktop has one package lane:
one vX.Y.Z tag and one immutable GitHub Release with all installers,
verification metadata, wheel, sdist, SBOM, and checksums. The same wheel
and sdist bytes publish to PyPI. The release workflow creates the complete
App-authored draft before it creates the tag. It publishes only after the
central release admission verifies that exact draft and artifact inventory.
Historical desktop-v* failures remain detector fixtures in the checker.
They do not define a current release lane.

lanes.name: Desktop package
lanes.remediation:
# Stage the complete reviewed package from current main.
gh workflow run release.yml --repo OpenAdaptAI/openadapt-desktop --ref main -f operation=stage -f version=X.Y.Z -f source_commit=COMMIT
# Obtain the exact active central admission for that draft and inventory.
# Publish the same draft and bytes.
gh workflow run release.yml --repo OpenAdaptAI/openadapt-desktop --ref main -f operation=publish -f version=X.Y.Z -f source_commit=COMMIT -f draft_release_id=ID -f admission_reference_json='REFERENCE_JSON'
